plain_english: At god's hour, surrender to the Lord. Then stillness, restraint, and the twilight rite. Two watches of muttering and worship, then the other session; the rest of time is Śiva's remainder-conduct.
sanskrit_cite: brāhme muhūrte bhagavatprapatti stataḥ samādhirniyamo'tha sāndhyaḥ | yāmau japārcādi tato'nyasatraṃ | śeṣastukālaḥ śivaśeṣavṛttiḥ

plain_english: A-first-faced, KA-handed, ṬA-footed, PĀ-sided with ṂA in the middle; YA-hearted goddess, consciousness-formed — Sarasvatī wins.
sanskrit_cite: ādimukhā kādikarā ṭādipadā | pādipārśvayuṅmadhyā | yādihṛdayā bhagavatī saṃvidrūpā | sarasvatī jayati

plain_english: Thought-jewel, wish-cow, wish-trees bear fruit — just men's desires. Unasked, unheaped, nourish man's aims, O mother's noble mood.
sanskrit_cite: phalanti cintāmaṇikāmadhenu kalpadrumāḥ kāṅkṣitameva puṃsām | aprārthitānapracitān pumarthān | puṣṇātu me māturudāra bhāvaḥ

plain_english: Without whom nothing at all is done, nothing known, nothing wanted — by the lord of awareness. To her, the highest, the mother of worlds — homage to Śivā, Śiva's beloved.
sanskrit_cite: yayā vinā naiva karoti kiñcan | na vetti nāpīcchati saṃvidīśaḥ | tasmai parasyai jagatāṃ jananyai | namaḥ śivāyai śivavallabhāyai

plain_english: Ever-risen, blessed, all-auspicious, Śiva-giving, dwelling in Śiva's heart, O Śivā — moonlight opening the night-lotus: for the worshipping mind, make my going in heaven supreme.
sanskrit_cite: sadodite bhagavati sarvamaṅgale | śivaprade śivahṛdayasthite śive | bhajanmanaḥ kumudavikāsacandrike | dvijanmanaḥ kuru mama khe gatiṃ pare

plain_english: Be gracious, all-auspicious Śivā, Śiva's beloved. Umā, Ramā, Sarasvatī — you alone are the supreme goddess.
sanskrit_cite: prasīda sarvamaṅgale śive śivasya vallabhe | ume rame sarasvati tvameva devatā parā

plain_english: O mother, O Ambikā, formless, nameless, Umā, Raudrī, Vāmā, Mahālakṣmī, Māyā — supreme goddess, sporting the five acts, auspicious Bhairavī, glorious: I surrender to you.
sanskrit_cite: ame ambike asvarūpe anākhye ume | raudri vāme mahālakṣmi māye | pare devate pañcakṛtyaikalole śive | bhairavi śrīmati tvāṃ prapadye

plain_english: Māyā, Vidyā, Mātṛkā, Mālinī — you throb in every body as awareness-spark-self. How shall I meditate you, self-flashing? I meditate you as inward-resounding speech.
sanskrit_cite: māye vidye mātṛke mālini tvaṃ | kāye kāye spandase citkalātmā | dhyāyeyaṃ tāṃ tvāṃ katha svasphurattāṃ | dhyāyeyaṃ tvāṃ vācamantarnadantīm
